cross_slice_join_obligations.J1: S1-owned infrastructure used by P2/P3A cases (constants, exceptions, _sha, _json_bytes, _exact, _meta, _error_type, _attempt, _exception_type, _all_closed, _settled, _state, _file_observation, _unknown_target, _same_unknown, _identity_matches, _Owned, _load_verified, _Clock, _IteratorProxy, _FaultOS, _raise_instance, _rule, _Fx, _Context) is reviewed for correctness in P1; P2/P3A use exact aliases and their verdicts are conditional on P1.
cross_slice_join_obligations.J2: run() (P1) dispatches by ID-tuple membership to _capture_case/_schema_case (P2) and _adapter_case (P3A), resets ctx.last_reader, re-checks the original deadline and the retained-budget latch after each case, then sets MATCH only if harness _exact(observed, expected); InconclusivePrecondition/deadline/budget/Exception/BaseException map to their statuses. P1 treats the case functions as declaration-only; P2/P3A receive exact run() excerpts as aliases.
cross_slice_join_obligations.J3: Plan/harness ID join: run() refuses unless plan case IDs equal RD+CA+SC+AD+DF+DP+DL tuples in order with the deferred/type/expected structure (P1 owns the check; preparer static join found equality); case-body ownership per section 2; P3B owns the global obligation join.
cross_slice_join_obligations.J4: _ref (owner P3A) is used by P1 _emit_case for oversize case-line detail references.
cross_slice_join_obligations.J5: InjectedConsumerFault (owner P3A) is used by P2 case CA100.
cross_slice_join_obligations.J6: RESULT, RECEIPT, _capture_record, _artifact, _base_records (owner P2) build the consumer E/O records used by P3A _adapter_fixture.
cross_slice_join_obligations.J7: Bootstrap state built in run() (P1): ctx.sources (pinned bytes), ctx.ns (verified non-main namespaces for reader/capture4/schema2/adapter3) and ctx.input_metadata (loader last_file after-metadata per pin) are consumed by P2 (SC32/SC33 gate identity, capture4/schema2 namespaces, plan/original bytes) and P3A (adapter3 namespace).
cross_slice_join_obligations.J8: Cross-case state: ctx.ca is built once by the first executed CA case and its directory descriptors close at that case end (later CA cases use paths/bytes only); ctx.retained/budget latch, ctx.proxies, ctx.retained_exception_readers and per-case owned.close_since(mark) cleanup are P1 lifecycle duties relied on by P2/P3A.
cross_slice_join_obligations.J9: Swallowed harness stops: HarnessDeadlineExceeded subclasses TimeoutError (an OSError) and capture4 treats OSError/ValueError from read_bytes as a defined read failure; schema2/adapter3 map Exception to X5/X7; a census-action fixture write can raise HarnessBudgetExceeded inside adapter3. P1 must show the post-case check() and budget latch convert these to NOT_RUN_DEADLINE/NOT_RUN_BUDGET before any MATCH; P2/P3A must not treat such swallowing as an owned boundary.
cross_slice_join_obligations.J10: reader1 text (embedded in P1, P2, P3A) is the same pinned file; P1 owns the reader-control cases; P2/P3A rely on its behavior for reach.
cross_slice_join_obligations.J11: Coverage join: every disposition coverage_map row, the deferred register and the retirement map are adjudicated in P3B, conditional on the per-case reach/attribution verdicts of P1/P2/P3A for the cases they own.
cross_slice_join_obligations.J12: Unwaived deferrals: DL01 (P1), DP00-DP23 (P2), DF01-DF15 (P3A) and the disposition deferred subcontrols stay mandatory; no packet may count an executable case toward them.
